title: BRAZIL'S CAPTAIN AND COACH BOTH SEE RED, THEN LOSE 3-2 TO JAPAN
description:
Japan's 91st-minute winner, then red cards for Brazil's captain and their coach.

Brazil lost 3-2 to Japan in Singapore, and the winner came in the 91st minute. Raphinha, the captain, had just promised to give his best for Brazil.

Then he protested the goal and was shown a red card. Carlo Ancelotti was sent off too, for the same protest.

It got stranger. Ancelotti served a one-match touchline ban against Singapore, and Raphinha was suspended as well. Bruno Guimaraes took the armband, and Brazil won 7-0.

Lose with the captain and the coach there, win 7-0 without them. Make of that what you will.

Pure coincidence, or did something really change? Pick your side in the comments.
